  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "The {{ing_01|hare}} is dressed, boned, the body spread out."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Garnished (with {{ing_02|pickling herbs}} and {{ing_03|spices}}) and hung into the smoke stack."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "When it has taken on color, cook it half done, wash it, sprinkle with {{ing_04|salt}} and immerse it in {{ing_05|wine sauce}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "In the mortar put {{ing_06|pepper}}, {{ing_07|lovage}}, and crush."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Moisten with {{ing_08|broth}}, {{ing_09|wine}} and {{ing_10|a little oil}}, heat."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "When boiling, bind with {{ing_11|roux}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Now detach the saddle of the roast {{ing_01|hare}}, sprinkle with {{ing_06|pepper}} and serve."
    }
  ],
